mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively impacted over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances productivity and efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of easing cycle instances with positive INDPRO growth, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, signaling strengthened housing demand, positively impacts consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of months with positive HOUST growth, or Rank IC < 0.035 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 3% YoY, signaling heightened inflation concerns, investors anticipate monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances with CPIAUCSL YoY growth above 3%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.015 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when PAYEMS growth decelerates (< 100k new jobs) and UNRATE rises above 4.2%, signaling labor market weakness, S&P 500 forward returns are negatively impacted over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 35% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in RSAFS, indicating strengthened retail sales, positively impacts business revenue expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but only during early-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of early-cycle expansion instances with positive RSAFS growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3.5-year rolling window.
